assessments.reasoning: October 2021 §§3.13.1–3.13.2 use if: Boolean! and allow field, fragment spread and inline fragment locations. §6.3.2 CollectFields skips the selection before branch-specific processing when either guard rejects. The dual-directive note confirms exclusion for a true skip or false include, subject to the frozen conditions.

challenge.method: Checked truth combinations of both directives and their allowed selection locations, then examined the pinned unless argument under the October 2021 signature.
challenge.results: The combined condition keeps a selection only when skip is false and include is true, subject to other execution rules. The sample’s unless argument is not the named built-in if argument.

limitations: The rule covers fields, fragment spreads, and inline fragments at allowed locations. Separate type-condition evaluation, validation and rendering rules still apply. The pinned unless argument is incompatible with the named built-in argument in this edition.
The assessment is confined to the named documents and revision scope.
